thread:
Lina: Quick sync on the lightweight Optimize advisor pilot. Goal: deliver route-level batching, prefix cache suggestions, quant profiles, and eval-triggered alerts for a small pilot. Keep MVP read-only (recommendations + manual apply).

Marco: Agreed. MVP scope suggestion: 1) per-route batching suggestion, 2) prefix KV cache candidate, 3) quant profile with expected quality delta estimate, 4) alerting when eval metrics drift beyond threshold. No autoscale or auto-apply for alpha.

Tess: Acceptance criteria idea: recommendations should have >=85% concordance with expert recommendations on a curated prompt set; median latency impact when applied <=7%; quant suggestions target <=2.5% expected quality delta. Alerts present sample failing examples and a triage bundle.

Owen: Ops/customer asks: Tenant opt-in is mandatory for private deployments. Dedicated customers want a ticketed apply workflow and per-tenant mapping to reserved pools.

Lina: Let's include a simple mapping schema in MVP (hosted vs dedicated) and mark full policy automation as stretch. Also include a console opt-in toggle (must exist before pilot).

Riley: UX: Console card should show estimated monthly savings, confidence score, predicted p50 latency delta, and a one-click "request apply" that creates a ticket for dedicated accounts. API should return a recommendations object for automation.

Marco: Sample alert config for ops review:

```
alert:
  name: "quality-drift"
  metric: "eval.concordance"
  window: "14d"
  threshold_pct: 4.0
  sample_size: 200
  notify: ["sre", "pm"]
  attach_triage_bundle: true
```

Tess: Privacy note: do not include raw prompts in outbound payloads unless tenant telemetry is opted in. Add telemetry_consent flag per tenant.

Lina: Launch checklist (alpha->pilot): 1) 2 pilot customers (hosted + dedicated), 2) docs + runbook + opt-in toggle, 3) E2E tests for batching/cache/quant paths, 4) eval harness with baseline prompt sets, 5) triage bundle implementation gated on privacy review.

Marco: Owners: Marco -> runtime heuristics + API schema; Tess -> eval harness + thresholds; Owen -> ops/ticket flow + privacy; Riley -> Console/UI; Lina -> PM + pilot coordination. Target alpha in 3 weeks.

ci-bot: deploy queued: optimize-advisor/alpha -> staging at 3299007799 by @ci-bot

Riley: CS ask: exportable triage bundle (examples + model context + timestamps) for customer handoff. Must respect telemetry consent.

Lina: We'll add triage bundle to backlog. Privacy gate blocks export features. If any blockers surface, ping here and we'll adjust scope. :thumbsup:
